definitions.explanation: Relating to or conforming to principles of right and wrong conduct. Describes behavior, judgments, or standards that align with accepted moral principles.

examples.japanese: {道徳的|どうとくてき}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{道徳的|どうとくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ。
examples.english: That is an act that is morally problematic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{道徳的|どうとくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even if something doesn't violate the law, it may be morally unacceptable.

notes:
USAGE:
The na-adjective form of ⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧ (morality, ethics) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix forming adjectives). Used to describe actions, people, or standards in terms of right and wrong. Can modify nouns ({道徳的|どうとくてき}な + noun) or be used adverbially ({道徳的|どうとくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道徳的|どうとくてき}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (moral judgment)
- {道徳的|どうとくてき}な⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (moral responsibility)
- {道徳的|どうとくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧ (morally right)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {倫理的|りんりてき}: ethical — very similar but more academic/philosophical
- ⟦{不道徳|ふどうとく}→不道徳：19100_fudoutoku⟧: immoral — the negative form
